content.short: NEAR Intents lets users state a desired swap and have solvers compete to fill it across chains.
content.description: NEAR Intents applies the intent model to cross-chain swapping: a user declares the outcome they want, not the path to it, and a network of solvers competes to deliver the best price with on-chain execution. Its 1-Click Swap API requests quotes, executes the swap and tracks status through a single set of endpoints. An explorer API exposes completed swaps, and fee configuration is set per integration. Supported chains and assets include Monad.
